scope: Birth and death years and places for deceased historical figures. Pins represent settlements or approximate localities rather than claimed exact buildings.

figures.name: Leonardo da Vinci
aliases: Leonardo di ser Piero da Vinci
figures.note: The exact birthplace is uncertain; Anchiano near Vinci is traditional. The birth pin represents the Vinci area. He died at Clos Lucé in Amboise.

figures.name: Michelangelo
figures.note: Caprese is now named Caprese Michelangelo. He died in Rome, although his burial is in Florence.

figures.name: Galileo Galilei
figures.note: Arcetri is now a neighbourhood of Florence; the marker represents the locality, not the exact villa.

figures.name: Isaac Newton
figures.note: Uses Gregorian years: his birth was 25 December 1642 in the contemporary English calendar, or 4 January 1643 Gregorian. He died in Kensington; Westminster Abbey is his burial place.

figures.name: Charles Darwin
figures.note: He died at Down House in Downe, historically Kent and now Greater London. Westminster Abbey is his burial place.

figures.name: Ada Lovelace
figures.note: She died in Marylebone. Both markers represent London at city scale.

figures.name: Marie Curie
figures.note: She died at the Sancellemoz sanatorium in Passy, Haute-Savoie, not the Paris district of Passy or the Panthéon where she was later reinterred.

figures.name: Ludwig van Beethoven
figures.note: His exact birth day is unrecorded, but baptism on 17 December 1770 establishes the birth year.

figures.name: Pablo Picasso
figures.note: He died in Mougins. Vauvenargues, where he was buried, is a different location.

figures.name: Mary Shelley
figures.note: Born in Somers Town and died at Chester Square. Both markers represent London at city scale.

figures.name: George Washington
figures.note: The birth marker represents the Popes Creek estate area, now preserved as a national monument. Birth year uses the modern calendar; the contemporary English date fell in 1731 Old Style.

figures.name: Abraham Lincoln

birth.place: Sinking Spring Farm, near Hodgenville, Kentucky, USA

figures.note: The birth pin represents the preserved farm site, not a claim about the original cabin’s exact footprint. Then in Hardin County, the site is now in LaRue County. He died in Washington, D.C., not at his burial site in Springfield.

sources.title: National Park Service — President Abraham Lincoln

figures.name: Harriet Tubman

birth.place: Dorchester County, near Madison, Maryland, USA

figures.note: Birth is usually dated circa 1822; older accounts give other years, including 1820. The precise birthplace is uncertain. The pin marks the Madison area, not an exact cabin site.

sources.title: National Park Service — Tubman frequently asked questions
National Park Service — determining Tubman’s birth year
Maryland Department of Natural Resources — Tubman timeline

figures.name: Frederick Douglass

birth.place: Tuckahoe area, near Cordova, Maryland, USA

figures.note: 1818 follows the surviving enslaver’s records; Douglass himself did not know his exact birth date. The birth pin represents the Cordova–Tuckahoe area, not the precise cabin site. He died at Cedar Hill in Washington, D.C.; Rochester is his burial place.

figures.name: Frida Kahlo
aliases: Magdalena Carmen Frida Kahlo y Calderón
figures.note: Both pins represent Coyoacán, then a settlement outside central Mexico City and now a city borough. The exact birth house is disputed; the locality and year are established.

figures.name: Simón Bolívar
aliases: Simon Jose Antonio de la Santisima Trinidad Bolivar y Palacios
figures.note: He died at the Quinta de San Pedro Alejandrino near Santa Marta. The pin represents Santa Marta, not his later burial place in Caracas.

figures.name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
figures.note: He died in Chetput, Madras. Some short biographies instead give Kumbakonam, where he grew up.

figures.name: Akira Kurosawa
figures.note: Born in what is now Shinagawa; died in Setagaya. Both markers represent Tokyo.

figures.name: Yasujirō Ozu
figures.note: Born in Fukagawa; died in Bunkyō. Both markers represent Tokyo, not his burial place in Kamakura.

figures.name: Yukio Mishima
figures.note: Born in Yotsuya; died at Ichigaya. Both markers represent Tokyo.

figures.name: Hokusai
figures.note: The birth date is uncertain; 1760 is the conventional birth year.

sources.title: Former Residence of Mao Zedong — Wikipedia
Former Residence of Deng Xiaoping — Wikipedia

figures.name: Ho Chi Minh
figures.note: Uses the generally accepted birth year of 1890; he also used other birth years in different records. The birthplace marker represents Hoàng Trù village.

sources.title: Hoàng Trù historic site — Vietnam tourism database
Hoàng Trù — GeoNames coordinates via Mapcarta

figures.name: José Rizal
aliases: Jose Protasio Rizal Mercado y Alonso Realonda
figures.note: He was executed at Bagumbayan, now Rizal Park in Manila.

figures.name: Benigno Aquino Jr.
figures.note: He was assassinated at Manila International Airport; the marker represents the airport complex.

figures.name: Kim Dae-jung
figures.note: Uses the actual Gregorian birth year of 1924, confirmed by his presidential library; some records give 1925. The birth marker represents Hauido island.

sources.title: Life chronology — Kim Dae-jung Presidential Library & Museum
